EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERALGovernment Notifications
REGULATIONS made by the Minister of Sports under Section 41 read with Section 31 of the Sports Act No. 25 of 1973 :-
HARIN FERNANDO,Minister of Telecommunication,Foreign Employment and SportsColombo,31st July, 2019.

The Regulations No. 01 of 2016 pertaining to National Sports Associations published in Gazette ExtraordinaryNo. 1990/23 dated 27.10.2016, Regulations, No. 2006/13 dated 13.02.2017, Regulations, No. 2017/41 dated 05.05.2017,Regulations, No. 2089/56 dated 22.09.2018, Regulations, No. 2093/39 dated 18.10.2018 and the Regulations, No. 2105/38dated 10.01.2019 are again amended as follows :
1. By repealing the Regulation 8(2) in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2089/56 dated 22.09.2018 and substitutingthe following Regulation :-

‘8(2) After having considered an appeal in regard to a decision given or action taken by a National SportsAssociation Registered by the Minister in charge of the subject of Sports or having considered a decisiongiven by the National Sports Association Election Committee such an appeal shall be submitted to a three-member Appeals Advisory Committee comprising of retired judges of the Supreme Court or retired SeniorPublic officers and the Appeals Advisory Committee shall notify the Minister in charge of the subject ofSports of its decision in writing within 07 days of the receipt of the said appeal.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A - PG 4624— 517 (08/2019)PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.
